notes: bbox is [lon_min, lat_min, lon_max, lat_max], EPSG:4326, longitude first.
An entry with bbox null is shown in the dashboard as unavailable, with its unavailable_reason. It is never queried.
validation describes the state of the EVIDENCE for the area, not the availability of the map. 'not_validated' means no complete, validated risk result has been produced for the area.
Only the london entry is the primary pilot. Other entries must pass their own checks; success in one city does not transfer to another.

areas.label: London, United Kingdom
areas.bbox_basis: Approximate envelope rounded outward from public extreme-point descriptions of Greater London (Crews Hill north, Ditches Lane south, North Ockendon east, M25 junction 14 west). Not verified against the ONS/GLA boundary polygon. It is a catalogue-search extent only, not the municipal boundary. Validation must use the boundary before results are reported as city-wide.

boundary.reason: Official Greater London boundary not obtained: ONS/data.gov.uk endpoints were unreachable from the build environment. No polygon has been substituted. See docs/data/vulnerability-dataset-selection.md.

validation_blockers: WorldPop Global2 GBR raster not downloaded in this environment (data hosts unreachable)
No heat-hazard source implemented (Landsat Collection 2 ST_B10 is the candidate; Sentinel-2 must not be used for land-surface temperature)
No licensed sensitivity or adaptive-capacity source verified; the England Indices of Deprivation 2025 (OGL v3, LSOA) is a candidate, not yet integrated
